resolution_note: Suspected deleted (most likely), based on the user's manual check on 5 November 2026: the profile is unavailable and the checked saved reel URLs redirect to the profile instead of displaying a reel. The user considers deletion more likely than a username change because reel URLs would normally remain accessible after a rename. This is a user-reported assessment, not an Instagram-confirmed deletion. All 39 discovered reel URLs and previously saved profile and reel information are preserved; missing reel details are attributed to the unavailable profile and are excluded from further analysis.
